parts.text: Explain the difference between research methods and research methodology.
Discuss the importance of research in society.
Distinguish between qualitative and quantitative research.
Briefly discuss the motivation for research.
Distinguish between conceptual and empirical research.
Discuss any four sampling methods in research.
Explain the characteristics of a good sample design.
Discuss the steps and techniques of defining a research problem.
Explain the features of a good research design.
Discuss the various data collection techniques used in research.
Discuss the scientific method in research, explaining the principles that form its foundation.
